status: Fictional studio packaging concept; illustrative product copy and nutrition values, not a commercial food label.
structure: Square-section one-litre paperboard gable-top milk carton, no plastic cap. Four equal-width faces. The roof ridge runs left to right when the front faces the camera. Triangular folded gable ends sit above the two side panels; green sloping roof faces sit above the front and back.
palette: Warm ivory paperboard, deep forest-green ink, muted sunrise-orange accent

front.graphic: Large forest-green mountain silhouette and small orange rising sun in lower half, ivory negative space, fine orange horizontal rule. No paragraphs on front.

right.graphic: Neat ruled nutrition table, small mountain icon at bottom

text: Every morning starts with a fresh perspective.
Pour a little possibility into your day.
back.graphic: Broad orange sunrise disk behind a layered forest-green mountain landscape, visually distinct from the front. Headline above, short copy below, small wordmark at bottom.

left.graphic: Small orange accent rule and a fictional barcode near bottom
